details:
It happens to everyone at anytime : having an avatar, hands in VR with controllers, ingame hands in a default state (the best way to know it is if the fingers move on their own a bit), wanting to use them to make facial expressions ; then wanting to come back to default, only to find out it doesn't want to come back to default, resulting in unwanted facial expression, or having to raise some fingers on the controller so the avatar "think" it's by default when it's not.

One common known trick is to remove the battery from the controller and put it back, and it works. The thing is, when going in another instance with the same avatar, the hands will be released "by default", meaning there is more going on : the question is, it can be controller-side, but can something be done vrc-side to send the signal to release the hands and come back in "default position" ?

Having such option would be neat ; not maybe the optimal solution, but still something to have hands coming back to normal, and also not having facial expressions when not desired.
title: Hand not coming back to default position : controller or vrc side ?
